measured: 2026-11-19, branch a055a7831 against main dcc3e0889 (the note's budget off, its own paragraph and table budgets kept). Half of step 2 of L14 (calibration per shell), stopped when L14 moved behind release 0.9.0; the rest is to measure on resumption.

phone.readers: index parse and note-source parse (the phone's read mode is its editor), under 128 MB

editor.note: not measured per form; the editor parses every note whole with CodeMirror, as on main, so its limit is a named limit, not the budget's
editor.missing: prose, paras, items, linked, tasks, quotes, tables50, bigtables under 128 MB
